function_specs.name: _EventDelete
function_specs.meaning: Frozen conditional Event deletion: inspect pending, drain if needed, unpublish under approved gap conditions, free the detached allocation, and schedule iff the earlier inspection was nonempty.

function_specs.name: CriticalAreaLock
function_specs.meaning: Preserve ordinary and approved Event gap resource-acquisition contracts.

function_specs.name: CriticalAreaUnLock
function_specs.meaning: Return the updated global invariant to the shared critical protocol.

function_specs.name: IsDoubleLinkListEmpty
function_specs.meaning: Reuse the exact generic pending DLL emptiness contract.

function_specs.name: IdRemoveObj
function_specs.meaning: Reuse both named contracts; express returned IdNode ownership with explicit typed field addresses to resolve QCP field-name ambiguity without semantic change.

function_specs.name: DoubleLinkListRmNode
function_specs.meaning: Reuse named node-removal contracts; selected generic member removal returns the payload and self-linked node.

function_specs.name: x_free
function_specs.meaning: Trusted release of the complete detached EventRaw allocation.

function_specs.name: KTASK_ASSIGN
function_specs.meaning: Existing outside-critical scheduling model invoked only when resched is nonzero.

function_specs.name: LinklistResumeAll
function_specs.meaning: Frozen Event OC batch wakeup contract with continuation for the remaining delete operation.

loop_invariants.progress: Retain the null branch condition, original abstract command and outside-critical resource; the loop has no terminating path.

new_predicates.name: event_delete_pending_restore
new_predicates.meaning: Wand restoring the same os_inv when the borrowed pending DLL is returned unchanged.
new_predicates.why_needed: IsEmpty needs exactly the pending DLL while other shared ownership remains framed.

new_predicates.name: event_delete_id_restore
new_predicates.meaning: Wand restoring the same os_inv after returning the read-only Event ID scalar.
new_predicates.why_needed: The single ID load must finish before the complete manager is passed to IdRemoveObj.

new_predicates.name: event_delete_finish
new_predicates.meaning: Existing guarded unpublish followed by the optional existing scheduling command.
new_predicates.why_needed: Names the residual operation whose continuation is passed through the OC ResumeAll call.

new_predicates.name: event_delete_resume_cont
new_predicates.meaning: Weakest-precondition continuation for completing deletion and scheduling after ResumeAll.
new_predicates.why_needed: Passing the final X directly to ResumeAll would omit the later unpublish/schedule effects.
